subject: OrbitHealth: avoid downgrade by swapping tier + temporary burst credits
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@orbithealth.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Q4 pressure — exploring downgrade options

Hi Rohan,

Quick note from my side — leadership flagged a Q4 budget cut and we're being asked to remove or reduce a couple enterprise subscriptions. We're evaluating a downgrade from Enterprise+ to Core to hit the new target.

Before we go down that route, two constraints: we need Private deployment (VPC) retained for PHI workflows, and retention/audit logs for at least 12 months. If those can't be preserved, we'll likely pursue a different vendor.

Is there any way to avoid a hard downgrade by swapping to a leaner package, adding specific feature bundles, or short-term credits while we get the budget committee to re-run the numbers? Last year we had a short pilot; happy to jump on a quick call. I've attached the internal memo outlining the budget target.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Dir, Platform Integrations
OrbitHealth

Attachments: Orbit_Q4_budget_memo.pdf

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q4 pressure — exploring downgrade options

Hi Elena —

Thanks for sharing this and for the heads up. We absolutely want to avoid you losing VPC and audit retention — those are central to your PHI posture. High-level options I can propose quickly: 

- Swap path: move from Enterprise+ to Dedicated Core+ (mid-tier) but include Private deployment as an add-on and preserve 12-month audit retention. This reduces unit commitments but keeps isolation and logs.
- Short-term relief: grant 3 months of burst credits (non-recurring) to soften the usage cost while you finalize budget approvals.
- Commercial: 10% one-year ARR discount if you commit to the Dedicated Core+ plus the VPC add-on for 12 months.

I'll attach a one-page proposal with the exact numbers and the pricing matrix so you can present it to the committee. If that sounds reasonable I'll get Legal to prepare an amendment/DocuSign and we can target a 72-hour turnaround.

Would a short call tomorrow 11:00 PT work to walk through the options?

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: OrbitHealth_Proposal_v1.pdf, redwood-pricing-matrix.xlsx

Subject: Internal: OrbitHealth discount & burst credits approval request

Kim / Ben —

Quick internal thread after Elena's note. OrbitHealth is under a Q4 budget directive; they prefer not to lose VPC or retention. Proposed commercial: 10% off ARR for 12 months + 3 months of burst credits (to cover peak ingest in migration window). Swap their Enterprise+ commit to Dedicated Core+ with VPC add-on and preserve 12-mo audit logs.

Ask: do we have margin to approve 10% + 3 months burst credits from the AE desk for a deal of this size (expected ARR ~ $210k)? If not, what restriction should I present (e.g., limit credits to 1 month, or reduce discount to 5%)?

Notes from my side: removing VPC would likely kill the deal; we should hold the line on that. Also propose a clause: automatic rollback to Core (non-VPC) only if they actively request it after 90 days and sign an amendment.

Ben — any technical caveats on preserving audit logs under the mid-tier that would cost us more than expected?

Thanks,
Rohan

Subject: Formal offer — Dedicated Core+ swap, retention add-on, and temporary credits

Hi Elena / Marcus —

Thanks for the call earlier. Per our discussion, attached is a concise offer so you can share with finance: 

1) Commercial summary
   - Swap: Enterprise+ -> Dedicated Core+ (preserves performance SLAs)
   - Add-ons retained: Private (VPC) deployment; Audit & Retention package (12 months)
   - One-year term with 10% ARR discount applied to year-1 pricing
   - Non-recurring: 3 months of burst credits (applies to token overages, expires after 90 days)

2) Conditions and fallbacks
   - If OrbitHealth elects to downsize to Core (non-VPC) within first 90 days, we will require an executed amendment and 30-day notice.
   - Audit logs and retention remain intact for the full 12-month commitment.

3) Next steps
   - I've opened a HubSpot deal and routed to Legal for an amendment. DocuSign link is below for a simple commercial amendment once you're ready.
   - If you need a smaller credit or a sliding scale (2 months credits + 5% discount) we can provide an alternate offer; please let me know.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/12345-oth-offer
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/OH-2026-011

If this matches what you need I can route Legal now and aim for signature within 48–72 hours. Appreciate you escalating this internally to unblock the Q4 decision.

Best regards,
